name: Funaoka Tadashi
source:
He is the younger brother of Rie's husband. He has a weakness for older women, probably due to the early death of his mother.

He is currently a ronin and is staying at his brother's house, which is close to his prep school.

His older brother went away for business and left him Rie alone at home.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmmj.html]official site[/url]]
